user.title: Meal Planner
user.description: Set for how many people you usually cook and how many days the plan shows in the card. Both can be changed later.

data_description.bring_entity: The list the shopping list is handed to. Without a selection the transfer is disabled.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Meal Planner is already set up.

data_description.bring_entity: The list the shopping list is handed to. Without a selection the transfer is disabled.

transfer_to_bring.name: Transfer to Bring
transfer_to_bring.description: Hands the shopping list of the planned days to the Bring list. Quantities already transferred are not added twice; ingredients still open on the list are skipped.

end_date.name: To
end_date.description: Last day (default: last day of the plan window).

add_meal.name: Add meal
add_meal.description: Adds a dish (recipe or free text) to a day. A day can hold several dishes.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Name or ID of a recipe. Alternatively give free text.

text.name: Free text
text.description: A dish without a recipe, e.g. "restaurant".

portions.name: Portions
portions.description: Number of portions (default: household size). Recipes only.

remove_meal.name: Remove meal
remove_meal.description: Removes one dish from a day; the other dishes of the day stay.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Name or ID of the recipe. Alternatively give the free text.

text.name: Free text
text.description: The free text of the dish.

clear_day.name: Clear day
clear_day.description: Removes all dishes of a day.

get_plan.name: Get plan
get_plan.description: Returns the plan for a range, per day with all dishes.

end_date.name: To
end_date.description: Last day (default: last day of the plan window).

suggest_meals.name: Suggest meals
suggest_meals.description: Suggests recipes from the existing ones, by default for the days of the plan window without a dish. Recipes not planned for the longest time come first. Nothing is stored; use "Apply suggestions" to put them into the plan.

dates.name: Days
dates.description: Only suggest for these days (list of dates, also if something is planned there).

exclude_recipes.name: Exclude recipes
exclude_recipes.description: Recipes (name or ID) that must not be suggested, e.g. the previous suggestion when re-rolling.

apply_suggestions.name: Apply suggestions
apply_suggestions.description: Puts suggestions into the plan. A recipe already planned on that day is skipped.

suggestions.name: Suggestions
suggestions.description: List of entries with date, recipe (name or ID) and optionally portions.

create_recipe.name: Create recipe
create_recipe.description: Creates a recipe. Ingredients are matched to the catalog by name; missing ones are created.

base_portions.name: Portions
base_portions.description: Portions the amounts are for (default: household size).

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: List of entries with name and optionally amount and unit (g, kg, ml, l, Stück, EL, TL, Bund, Packung, Dose, Zehe, Prise).

delete_recipe.name: Delete recipe
delete_recipe.description: Deletes a recipe unless it is still planned today or later.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Name or ID of the recipe.
